reason: Reviewed all five surfaces for named folder Projects. Outside a Git repository, a folder the User registered with `notifai project folder add <path> --name <name>` (or any folder inside it) now supplies the Project; a Git repository inside it keeps its own, and explicit, configured and --projectless choices still win. Notifai skill: the setup section now names the command for when the User asks to make a plain folder a Project, beside the per-project enable/disable switch; the release note says the same. Lifecycle hooks: SessionStart guidance and Project Enablement follow the inferred folder Project for descendant folders (covered by the change's tests); hook wording is unchanged. CLI readiness: doctor and project status report the folder Project the same way as an inferred Git Project; no new readiness state. Harness setup and domain terms: unchanged (a Project is still the Account-owned identity; only its inference source widened).
